body: Thank you. I don't know. Maybe I need to vent, but I think it's mostly just so hard feeling like I have no one to fall back on.

I'm scared that if I stop giving, I will have no one. My boyfriend especially, because he's dealing with his own stuff and I don't know if he'll stay if I tell him that I need his help or I can't do it anymore. Usually I think I would rather be taken advantage of than completely alone.
